import numpy as np

from tvb.simulator.models.base import Model


class MorrisLecar(Model):

    I = NArray(
        label=r":math:`I`", default=np.array([0.15]), doc="""Applied current I."""
    )
    V3 = NArray(
        label=r":math:`V3`",
        default=np.array([0.1]),
        doc="""Half-activation parameter V3.""",
    )
    V1 = NArray(
        label=r":math:`V1`",
        default=np.array([-0.0]),
        doc="""Half-activation parameter V1.""",
    )
    V2 = NArray(
        label=r":math:`V2`", default=np.array([0.15]), doc="""Slope factor V2."""
    )
    V4 = NArray(
        label=r":math:`V4`", default=np.array([0.1]), doc="""Slope factor V4."""
    )
    VCa = NArray(
        label=r":math:`VCa`",
        default=np.array([1.0]),
        doc="""Calcium reversal potential.""",
    )
    VL = NArray(
        label=r":math:`VL`",
        default=np.array([-0.5]),
        doc="""Leak reversal potential.""",
    )
    VK = NArray(
        label=r":math:`VK`",
        default=np.array([-0.7]),
        doc="""Potassium reversal potential.""",
    )
    gCa = NArray(
        label=r":math:`gCa`", default=np.array([1.2]), doc="""Calcium conductance."""
    )
    gK = NArray(
        label=r":math:`gK`", default=np.array([2.0]), doc="""Potassium conductance."""
    )
    gL = NArray(
        label=r":math:`gL`", default=np.array([0.5]), doc="""Leak conductance."""
    )
    tau = NArray(
        label=r":math:`tau`",
        default=np.array([3.0]),
        doc="""Recovery time constant τ.""",
    )

    _nvar = 2
    state_variables = ["V", "N"]

    state_variable_range = Final(
        label="State Variable ranges [lo, hi]",
        default={
            "V": np.array([-1000000000.0, 1000000000.0]),

        },

    variables_of_interest = List(

        label="Variables watched by Monitors",
        choices=("V", "N"),

        doc="""Default state variables to be monitored.""",
    )

    parameter_names = List(
        of=str,
        label="List of parameters for this model",
        default=[
            "I",

            "V1",
            "V2",
            "V4",
            "VCa",
            "VL",
            "VK",
            "gCa",
            "gK",
            "gL",
            "tau",
        ],

    local_parameter_names = []

    state_variable_dfuns = Final(
        label="Drift functions",
        default={
            "V": "I - gL*(V - VL) - M*gCa*(V - VCa) - N*gK*(V - VK)",
            "N": "(G - N)/tau",
        },
    )

    cvar = np.array([], dtype=np.int32)

    coupling_terms = Final(label="Coupling terms", default=[])

    _R = None
    _stimulus = 0.0
    use_numba = False

    def dfun(self, state_variables, coupling, local_coupling=0):

        # shape (n_sv, n_modes)
        V = state_variables[0, :]
        N = state_variables[1, :]

        I = self.I
        V3 = self.V3
        V1 = self.V1
        V2 = self.V2
        V4 = self.V4
        VCa = self.VCa
        VL = self.VL
        VK = self.VK
        gCa = self.gCa
        gK = self.gK
        gL = self.gL
        tau = self.tau

        # Coupling Terms (from coupling array)

        # Derived Variables
        self.G = G = 0.5 + 0.5 * np.tanh((V - V3) / V4)
        self.M = M = 0.5 + 0.5 * np.tanh((V - V1) / V2)

        # Time Derivatives
        # Broadcast every derivative to a common per-node shape so constant
        # (state-independent) derivatives — e.g. ``duA/dt = cA`` — stack into a
        # homogeneous array alongside node-shaped ones, matching TVB's own
        # ``numpy.full_like`` handling of constant drifts.
        _derivs = np.broadcast_arrays(
            np.asarray(
                I - gL * (V - VL) - M * gCa * (V - VCa) - N * gK * (V - VK)
            ),  # V
            np.asarray((G - N) / tau),  # N
        )
        return np.array(_derivs)
